comparison_design: Single-pass screening; reused MTP3 is historical, no ABBA/order-drift confidence. Repeat only ambiguous cells.

paired_cases.interpretation: Observed serving performance, not isolated kernel speed. Cold C4 may mix decode with other prefills. Warm cache residency can differ between depths; report actual hits and misses. Output sequences can differ, changing acceptance work. No single-pass confidence interval.
